scope_guards: A planning fire statement is not treated as building-control approval.
Approved Document guidance is not treated as automatic legal compliance.
The 30 September 2026 second-stair amendment is not applied before its commencement date.
A fire strategy is not treated as installed and commissioned systems.
A fire-risk assessment is not treated as completed remediation.
Building-regulation approval is not treated as discharge of Fire Safety Order duties.
Fire-service consultation is not treated as approval of all fire-engineering assumptions.
No score or promotion is written without exact design, approvals, installation, commissioning, handover, risk assessment and operational controls.
